purpose: Materialize the three point-in-time input frames required by the Run287 scientific weighting readiness gate without fitting a model or changing a portfolio.

component_frame.availability_policy: every observed raw component requires its own UTC available-from field on or before the row decision time
component_frame.transform: within each decision date, rank only finite observed values by average percentile and subtract 0.5; never turn missing or unobserved values into zero

label_policy.entry: first NYSE session strictly after feature_date
label_policy.exit: the horizon-th price interval after entry, using exact NYSE sessions
label_policy.availability: maximum of the four endpoint price availability timestamps and the scheduled exit close

scored_snapshot_adapter.role: diagnostic bridge for exact scored snapshots only; it cannot make historical membership PIT-clean
scored_snapshot_adapter.stable_id_fallback: UNVERIFIED_SEC_CIK or UNVERIFIED_TICKER, which always forces pit_universe_label_clean=false

daily_returns.gap_policy: do not compute a multi-session return across a missing NYSE session
daily_returns.availability: maximum of current and prior endpoint availability timestamps

selector_price_map_adapter.role: diagnostic bridge for the hash-pinned selector archive
selector_price_map_adapter.path_resolution: resolve one archive member by declared basename and exact SHA-256; never trust the stored machine path
selector_price_map_adapter.identity_policy: join exact ticker to the component identity map; benchmark SPY uses BENCHMARK:SPY

prior_weights.source_hash: SHA-256 of the exact source target-book bytes repeated on every output row
accepted_provenance: exact member of the hash-pinned Run287 research-static archive
separate accepted research-prior attestation bound to the exact source SHA-256
prior_weights.cash_policy: preserve an explicit CASH row when present; do not redistribute cash into equities
